limits: Launch-to-exit profile includes setup, warmup, follower verification, latency sorting and shutdown; not the throughput timer boundary.
CPU deltas are interval observations assigned to sampled stacks, not instruction-level cost or elapsed wall percentages.
Samply 0.13.1 sidecar coalesces inline/source chains by native symbol start address; inline lines are representative, not per-RVA precise.
Sampled stack unwinder truncation not explicitly marked in these files cannot be quantified; null/malformed/unresolved observations are retained and counted.
matched-server thread names do not identify leader/follower ownership; no leader-specific CPU claim.
